# Get all green block positions and click them all
seg = current_frame.segmentation
greens = [n for n in seg['nodes'] if n['color'] == 'N']
print(f"Green blocks: {len(greens)}")

# Get center of each green block
clicks = []
for g in greens:
    b = g['boundary']
    minr = min(row for row, col in b)
    maxr = max(row for row, col in b)
    minc = min(col for row, col in b)
    maxc = max(col for row, col in b)
    center_r = (minr + maxr) // 2
    center_c = (minc + maxc) // 2
    clicks.append({'action': 'MOUSE', 'row': center_r, 'col': center_c})

# Sort by row then column for consistent order
clicks.sort(key=lambda x: (x['row'], x['col']))
print(f"Clicking {len(clicks)} green blocks:")
for c in clicks:
    print(f"  ({c['row']}, {c['col']})")

# Execute all clicks
action(clicks)

seg2 = current_frame.segmentation
greens2 = [n for n in seg2['nodes'] if n['color'] == 'N']
print(f"\nAfter clicks: {len(greens2)} green blocks")

print(f"level_completed={last_action_result.get('level_completed')}")
print(f"done={last_action_result.get('done')}")

# If all cleared, move LEFT
if len(greens2) == 0:
    print("\nAll cleared! Moving LEFT...")
    action(['LEFT'])
    print(f"level_completed={last_action_result.get('level_completed')}")
    print(f"done={last_action_result.get('done')}")
